facts.fact: 匿名日记（Voices from the Void 摘录）作者称 Day 3 in the fifth 时断言同伴已不是 Slate，扬言把他剖开证明
facts.anchor: that isn’t really Slate. I’m going to have to cut him open and prove it.

facts.fact: Petra 醒来见左前臂已在肘部被截断，同伴称必须砍到肘部才能留下干净断口
facts.anchor: They must’ve had to lop it off at the elbow so there would be a clean break.

facts.fact: Jade（挚友兼潜航搭档）告诉 Petra 她已经昏迷了 Eight hours
Flint（童年玩伴兼队友）用 Void puffer fish 的胰腺组织做 limb patch，替 Petra 装上断肢
facts.anchor: It’s made from the pancreatic tissue of Void puffer fish

facts.fact: Jade 在 Petra 大腿涂 burn jelly 逼幼虫爬出皮外，Flint 用镊子夹走最后一条扔进火里
facts.anchor: Jade smears burn jelly over my thighs

facts.fact: Flint 指控 Jade 在他新绳上割出规律切口（他称她还割开过他的呼吸管）
facts.anchor: She tampered with my ropes, left them full of little cuts

facts.fact: Flint 向 Petra 承认 Jade 所说的捐款箱失窃者就是他自己——five nox
facts.anchor: I’m the one who put five nox in there!

facts.fact: Flint 从 Jade 的包里抓走一根新绳并宣布独自离开；Petra 拒绝跟他走
facts.anchor: Flint grabs a rope from Jade’s bag.
